input.prompt: Instrumental orchestral piece without singing. A whimsical storybook overture for the opening screen of a cosy family adventure game. It begins with a sparkling celesta and harp flourish, then a bright, catchy melody on flute and clarinet over bouncing pizzicato strings; warm horns answer, a cheeky bassoon counter-melody, glockenspiel sparkles, light snare and timpani, rising to a joyful, heroic full orchestra. Major key, about 112 BPM, playful and warm, polished modern orchestral recording.
